limits: The image lacked system ripgrep. OpenCode search tools attempted a bootstrap download denied by the sandbox. Keep these attempts as historical v4 evidence; exclude them from v5 recommendations.
Real paid CLI execution on small synthetic contracts; not a general model benchmark.
Shared host under memory pressure; end-to-end elapsed times include sandbox/CLI startup and checks.
Native cost estimates are not invoices or Go quota balances. Missing usage is not zero cost.
Recorded human assistance is not a proof that every intervention was reported.
Two repetitions and deterministic eligibility do not establish statistical superiority.
